Daniel Alvarez is a skilled trial attorney at Franco Munoz, known for delivering real wins for injured workers. A graduate of UC Hastings (now UC Law SF), Daniel combines a big-firm experience with sharp litigation instincts to get results where it counts.

Before advocating for injured workers, Daniel gained invaluable experience at KPMG US LLP and PwC, where he worked on complex tax and real estate transactions. That background sharpened his ability to analyze financials, navigate regulations, and spot inconsistencies—skills he now uses to challenge insurers, expose employer and insurance misconduct, and maximize compensation for his clients.

Since joining the firm in 2023, Daniel has secured six-figure settlements, retroactive disability awards, and trial victories on issues ranging from invalid modified work offers, securing state doctor evaluators to benefit applicant’s cases, to cross-examining hostile witnesses. His courtroom confidence and trial muscle memory make him a force in every phase of litigation.

At the core of Daniel’s practice is a simple mission: hold insurance companies accountable and fight for the compensation injured workers deserve.

Notable Case Results

$109,000 Settlement – Denied Cumulative Trauma to the Shoulders, Elbows, Knees, Back, Hips, and Vision/Eyes. 

An industrial worker was injured as a result of working as a roofer for over 20 years. The insurance carrier denied the claim and Daniel fought zealously to secure a favorable outcome for the applicant. This resulted in taking a denied claim to securing a settlement of $109,000 for the injured worker.
Award Value: $109,000

$105,000 Retroactive Temporary Disability Award – Initially Denied Claim

A 68 year old industrial worker was denied a cumulative trauma workers compensation injury of working at a factory for over 40 years. Despite the defense’s initial attempt at a claim denial, we secured acceptance of the claim and secured a retroactive temporary disability benefit of $105,000 that was owed to the injured worker.

Award Value: $105,020.96

$110,000 – Denied Hernia for Concierge Worker

An injured worker who slipped and injured his back, knee, and who developed a hernia as a result of the fall, was initially denied treatment for the body parts. Daniel secured an acceptance of the claim, and had the carrier accept the hernia resulting in a settlement of $110,000 for the applicant.
Settlement Value: $110,000

Why Clients Choose Daniel Alvarez

  • Personal Commitment: Daniel treats every client with respect, compassion, and individualized attention.
  • Dedicated Advocacy: Whether it be a denied claim, or an unreasonable settlement offer, Daniel will fight to the end to get the result you deserve.
  • Six-Figure Settlements: Daniel will take a case to trial when others will not, while crafting every legal strategy with precision and care for your case. Daniel has consistently secured six-figure settlements for his clients ensuring that his clients receive long-overdue benefits.

If you've been injured on the job and aren’t getting the care or compensation you need, contact Franco Muñoz, APC today.
